overview.Name: Seapeak LLC
overview.Description: Seapeak LLC provides marine transportation services focusing on liquefied Natural Gas and Natural Gas Liquid. Seapeak LLC was formerly known as Teekay LNG Partners L.P. and changed its name to Seapeak LLC in February 2022. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
